title: 第十章 灰烬与余烬
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

火焰烧到最旺的时候，天已经完全亮了。

十六具丧尸的尸体堆在物流园东侧的荒地上，浇了整整两桶汽油。火舌舔着那些扭曲的灰色肢体，油脂在高温下发出噼噼啪啪的爆裂声，黑烟滚滚而上，在晨光里拉出一道笔直的烟柱，高到整个城北工业区都能看见。

林越站在离火堆十米远的上风口，用袖子捂住口鼻。烧丧尸的味道和烧任何东西都不一样——腐肉里的体液蒸发时会带出一股甜腻到让人反胃的气味，混合着汽油的刺鼻和骨骼烧裂的焦臭。前世他闻了五年，直到重生之后才知道正常世界的空气是什么味道。而此刻，正常世界的味道正在被这道烟柱一寸一寸地烧掉。

赵铭站在他旁边，脸上的黑血已经用袖子擦过了，但没擦干净，颧骨上还留着一道暗红色的印子。他的匕首已经擦干净插回腰间，工兵铲杵在地上，铲刃上残留的黑渍被火光照得发亮。从凌晨三点到现在，他一共杀了四只丧尸。第一只捅偏了，后三只是一刀一个。进步速度远超林越的预期。

“林哥。”赵铭看着火焰，没有转头，“刚才那个舔食者——你说前世杀了十一只。那这一世除了它，还会有多少？”

“不知道。”林越说，“前世第一只舔食者出现在末世第九天。现在它提前了六天。”

赵铭沉默了一会儿。“这意味着什么？”

“意味着这一世的病毒演化速度比前世更快。尸王也会更早出现。”

赵铭握着工兵铲的手指收紧了一点，没有说话。

陆寒霜从正门方向走过来，手里拎着那把已经擦干净的哑光黑匕首。她走到林越另一侧站定，看了一眼火堆，然后说了一句跟赵铭完全不同方向的话。

“烟柱太高。方圆五公里都能看到。今天是末世第二天，还在城里活着的人会往有烟的地方靠——他们会以为这里有救援。”

林越点头。他知道这一点。他点这一把火的时候就知道。“烧完这批尸体，至少还要半小时。让老郑和小何上哨塔，大刘在正门守着。从现在到中午，可能会有第一批幸存者摸过来。”

“收不收？”陆寒霜问。

“单个的，没被咬的，收。带武器的先缴械，登记，隔离观察六个小时。成群的不收——让他们往北走，给他们两瓶水和一包压缩饼干，告诉他们北边有军方的临时安置点。”

“北边真有？”

“有。”林越说，“但不是现在。前世北边的军方安置点在末世第五天才建立。这两天他们去了也找不到。但我们需要他们往北走——如果让他们留在这片工业区，不出一天就会有人打基地的主意。”

陆寒霜看了他一眼，眼神里是一种不太容易读懂的评估。她不是不赞同，而是在把这个决策放进自己的战术框架里验证。过了几秒钟，她微微点了一下头。

“我同意。但我补充一条——如果有携带有用技能的幸存者，可以酌情例外。医生、护士、工程师、无线电操作员，这类人就算成群也值得冒风险。”

“你来判断。”林越说，“你是战斗组组长，人员甄别交给你。但不管收谁——隔离六小时的规矩不能破。”

“明白。”

火堆里一根烧断的腿骨从柴堆上滚落下来，溅起一蓬火星。林越退后一步，火星落在他靴尖前面的焦土上，闪烁了两下就灭了。

他转过身，朝冷库走去。走过正门的时候，他看到赵德柱蹲在配电房旁边的荒地上。这个五十八岁的老农从凌晨被关进三号冷库到现在，出来之后做的第一件事不是休息，不是问外面发生了什么，而是继续用手抓土。他抓了一把冲积土放在掌心里搓，搓完放在鼻子跟前闻，然后把土放回去，又抓了一把更深层的，重复同样的动作。

“赵叔。”林越走过去，“外面的烟还没散，你先别在外面待太久。”

赵德柱抬起头看着他。这张被风霜刻满了沟壑的脸上没有恐惧，甚至没有太多波动。他的眼睛在晨光里有些浑浊，但浑浊之下是一种见过太多生死之后才会有的平静。

“我年轻的时候在部队，”赵德柱拍了拍手上的土，站起来，“打过仗。对面的人拿枪，我们拿锄头。打完仗回去接着种地。死人见过，火烧过村子也见过。”他指了指东边那道冲天的黑烟柱，“这个味道跟那时候不一样。但这个——烟——是一样的。”

林越看着他。前世他知道赵德柱沉默寡言，但从来不知道他年轻时打过仗。这让他意识到一件事——前世他对赵德柱的了解只停留在末世第二年以后的农人身份上。这个人之前的人生，他没有问过。

“地怎么样？”林越换了个话题。

“还行。冲积土，底肥不够，得堆一次绿肥。我看配电房后面有一片杂草，长得比别处都高，说明底下土壤的有机质比这边多。先把那一片开出来。”赵德柱说着，忽然停了一下，然后用一种很平的语气问，“你们刚才在外面杀的那些——是人变的？”

“是人变的。”

“还会再来吗？”

“会。”

Page (1/3)

When the flames were at their strongest, it was already completely light.

The corpses of sixteen zombies were piled on the wasteland on the east side of the logistics park, and two full barrels of gasoline were poured on them.The tongues of fire licked those twisted gray limbs, the grease crackled under the high temperature, and the black smoke rolled upwards, pulling out a straight smoke column in the morning light, so high that it could be seen in the entire industrial area in the north of the city.

Lin Yue stood upwind ten meters away from the fire, covering his mouth and nose with his sleeves.The smell of burning zombies is different from burning anything - when the body fluids in the rotting flesh evaporate, it will bring out a sweet and nauseating smell, mixed with the pungent smell of gasoline and the burning smell of cracked bones.He had smelled it for five years in his previous life, and he didn't know what the air in the normal world smelled like until he was reborn.At this moment, the smell of the normal world is being burned away inch by inch by this smoke column.

Zhao Ming stood next to him. The black blood on his face had been wiped with his sleeve, but not clean. There was still a dark red mark on his cheekbones.His dagger had been cleaned and inserted back into his waist, and the sapper's shovel was placed on the ground. The remaining black stains on the shovel blade were illuminated by the firelight.From three o'clock in the morning to now, he has killed four zombies in total.The first one missed the target, and the last three were just one stab at a time.The speed of progress far exceeded Lin Yue's expectations.

"Brother Lin." Zhao Ming looked at the flames without turning his head, "The licker just now - you said you killed eleven in the previous life. How many more will there be besides it in this life?"

"I don't know." Lin Yue said, "The first licker appeared on the ninth day of the end of the world in the previous life. Now it is six days earlier."

Zhao Ming was silent for a while."What does this mean?"

"It means that the virus in this life evolves faster than in the previous life. The Corpse King will also appear earlier."

Zhao Ming tightened his grip on the engineer shovel and said nothing.

Lu Hanshuang walked from the direction of the main entrance, holding the clean matte black dagger in his hand.She walked to stand on the other side of Lin Yue, glanced at the fire, and then said something completely different from Zhao Ming's.

"The smoke column is too high. It can be seen within a radius of five kilometers. Today is the second day of the apocalypse. People who are still alive in the city will move to places with smoke - they will think that there is rescue here."

Lin Yue nodded.He knows this.He knew it when he lit this fire."It will take at least half an hour to burn these corpses. Let Lao Zheng and Xiao He go to the sentry tower, and Da Liu will guard the main gate. From now to noon, the first batch of survivors may come over."

"Should you accept it or not?" Lu Hanshuang asked.

"Single ones, those who haven't been bitten, collect them. Those with weapons should be disarmed first, registered, and isolated and observed for six hours. Don't collect those in groups - let them go north, give them two bottles of water and a pack of compressed biscuits, and tell them that there is a temporary military settlement in the north."

"Is there really one in the north?"

"Yes," Lin Yue said, "but not now. The military settlement in the north of the previous life was only established on the fifth day of the apocalypse. They have been there for the past two days and can't find it. But we need them to go north - if we let them stay in this industrial area, someone will plan to build a base within a day."

Lu Hanshuang glanced at him, with an evaluation in his eyes that was not easy to read.It's not that she disagrees, but she is putting this decision into her own tactical framework to verify it.After a few seconds, she nodded slightly.

"I agree. But I will add one more thing - if there are survivors with useful skills, exceptions can be made where appropriate. Doctors, nurses, engineers, radio operators, these people are worth the risk even if they are in groups."

"You decide." Lin Yue said, "You are the leader of the combat team, and the personnel selection is left to you. But no matter who is accepted - the six-hour isolation rule cannot be broken."

"Understood."

A broken leg bone rolled down from the pyre in the fire, sending up a cloud of sparks.Lin Yue took a step back, and sparks fell on the scorched earth in front of the toes of his boots, flickering twice and then extinguishing.

He turned around and walked towards the cold storage.When he walked through the main entrance, he saw Zhao Dezhu squatting on the wasteland next to the power distribution room.This fifty-eight-year-old farmer has been locked in the No. 3 cold storage since early in the morning. The first thing he did after coming out was not to rest or ask what happened outside. Instead, he continued to grab the soil with his hands.He grabbed a handful of alluvial soil and rubbed it in his palms. After rubbing it, he put it in front of his nose and smelled it. Then he put the soil back, grabbed a handful deeper, and repeated the same action.

"Uncle Zhao." Lin Yue walked over, "The smoke outside hasn't cleared yet, so don't stay outside for too long."

Zhao Dezhu raised his head and looked at him.There was no fear or even much fluctuation on this face that was covered with ravines carved by wind and frost.His eyes were a little cloudy in the morning light, but beneath the cloudiness was a kind of calmness that only comes after seeing too many lives and deaths.

"When I was in the army when I was young," Zhao Dezhu clapped the dirt on his hands and stood up, "I fought in a war. The people on the other side took guns, and we took hoes. After the war, we went back to farming. We have seen dead people, and we have seen fires burning through villages." He pointed to the column of black smoke rising to the sky in the east. "This smell is different from that time. But this - smoke - is the same."

Lin Yue looked at him.In his previous life, he knew that Zhao Dezhu was taciturn, but he never knew that he had fought in a war when he was young.This made him realize one thing - his understanding of Zhao Dezhu in his previous life was only as a farmer after the second year of the apocalypse.He had not asked about this person's previous life.

"How is the land?" Lin Yue changed the topic.

"It's not bad. The alluvial soil doesn't have enough base fertilizer, so I need to pile up green manure. I see a patch of weeds behind the power distribution room. They grow taller than anywhere else, which means the soil underneath has more organic matter than here. Get that patch out first." Zhao Dezhu said, suddenly paused, and then asked in a very calm tone, "The ones you just killed outside - were they transformed by humans?"

"It's people who change."

"Will you come again?"

"Yes."
